senses.gloss:
लुट्(ऌ)लुटॢ r. 1st cl. (लोटति-ते)
 1. To shine.
 2. To resist.
 3. To suffer
pain. r. 4th cl. (लुट्यति)
 1. To stir, to agitate.
 2. To be joined or
connected with.
 3. To roll upon the ground.
 4. To rob. r. 1st cl.
(लोटति)
 1. To resist or oppose.
 2. To strike again.
 3. To shine. r.
6th cl. (लुटति) To embrace. r. 10th cl. (लोटयति-ते)
 1. To speak.
 2.
To shine, (इ) लुटि r. 1st and 10th cls. (लुण्टति लुण्टयति)
 1. To steal,
to rob or plunder.
 2. To disregard, to disobey or disrespect.
 3. To
be lame.
 4. To be idle.

लुट्यत् mfn. (-ठ्यन्-ठ्यन्ती-ठ्यत्) Rolling about, (in pain or grief.)
 E. ल्युट to roll about, शतृ aff.
